entities.name: Query dihydroxy-acid dehydratase
observations: 577 aa enzyme sequence has ILVD_EDD_N (PF00920) and ILV_EDD_C (PF24877) domains.
Strong homology to reviewed dihydroxy-acid dehydratases: 70.7–75.0% identity over about 97% query coverage.
Predicted catalytic activity is EC 4.2.1.9 dihydroxy-acid dehydratase.
Homolog annotations report one [2Fe-2S] cluster and Mg2+ per subunit; enzyme is typically a homodimer.

entities.name: Dihydroxy-acid dehydration
observations: Catalyzes dehydration of (2R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate to 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate plus H2O (Rhea RHEA:24809).
Catalyzes dehydration of (2R,3R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylpentanoate to (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate plus H2O (Rhea RHEA:27694).

entities.name: Branched-chain amino acid biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme performs the penultimate precursor-forming step in L-valine and L-isoleucine biosynthesis.

entities.name: Dihydroxy-acid dehydratase cofactors
observations: Reviewed homologs bind a [2Fe-2S] cluster acting as a Lewis-acid cofactor and Mg2+.
